newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to sell Banco Latino branches.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to sell Banco Latino branches.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade said it had set a base price of 20.889 billion bolivars ($43 million) for the network of branches of state bank Banco Latino, auctions for which will start June 6.
The branches will be sold in five groups of about nine in each group, Fogade said in a release. It did not say how many branches would be auctioned in total.
Banco Latino fell into state hands in January 1994, sparking a financial sector crisis that saw about half the Venezuelan banking sector collapse over the next two years.
The Banco Latino branches sell-off has attracted interest from most of Venezuela's leading banks, including Banco Provincial, Banco Mercantil and Banco Consolidado, Fogade said.
